## 01_input_data

```{r input_data}
data_all<-read.csv("01_input_data/data_all.csv")
gene_annotation<-read.csv("01_input_data/gene_annotation.csv")
sample_annotation<-read.csv("01_input_data/sample_annotation.csv")
genelist<-read.delim("01_input_data/genelist_s2931375.txt")
```


## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
